author: Dennis Easterday
text: I find it much easier to apply when standing in front of a mirror, so I can see that it is centered in the middle of the back of the arm.  Just keep in the back of your mind that it is possible that you could hit an artery during application.  From my experience (it's happened 3 times), it doesn't hurt, but blood may drip out through the sensor.  The good news is that it does not impact the sensor (it still works), and usually the bleeding stops in a short period of time.  So if it happens, don't panic!!!
